description: Source code for an OpenAI API provider class, handling streaming and non-streaming chat completions, model configuration, and error handling.

classes.name: OpenAiHandler
classes.description: A class that manages interactions with the OpenAI API, supporting streaming and non-streaming chat completions, model configuration, and error handling.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a chat message stream based on system prompt, messages, and metadata, handling different model types and streaming options.

methods.name: processUsageMetrics
methods.description: Processes usage data from API responses into a standardized format.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model configuration and info, ensuring support for native tool calling.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with the OpenAI API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: handleO3FamilyMessage
methods.description: Handles message creation for O3 family models, supporting streaming and non-streaming modes.

methods.name: handleStreamResponse
methods.description: Processes streaming response chunks from the API, yielding text, tool calls, and usage data.

methods.name: processToolCalls
methods.description: Processes tool call data from stream chunks, managing active tool call IDs and emitting partial/end events.

methods.name: _getUrlHost
methods.description: Extracts the host from a base URL.

methods.name: _isGrokXAI
methods.description: Determines if the URL host indicates GrokXAI.

methods.name: _isAzureAiInference
methods.description: Checks if the URL host indicates Azure AI inference service.

methods.name: addMaxTokensIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds max_completion_tokens to request options if configured, supporting O3 models.
